description:
My brand new T4 staged map. It consists of five stages and two additional bonus stages. 

While the main map is around T4 there are brief portions where the difficulty will dip significantly below and slightly higher than T4. The first additional bonus, created by Sagan, is intended to be approximately T3. The second additional bonus, created by Xtra_Festive, is intended to be approximately T5. 

This is my first ever published map that is reminiscent of older mapping styles and formatting. In my map I integrate small bhop portions to the surf to change things up a bit. I hope to expand on these new ideas and concepts moving forward in my next projects.

I would like to extend a HUGE thank you and shout out to all of my testers and friends that have answered each and every question and walked me through even the most basic concepts. I would like to especially thank Xtra for his many lessons and bits of feedback and Sagan for consistently motivating me to be the best I can be.

Thank you so much to anyone who plays this map! I hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

description:
bhop_museum2

This map functions in a similar way to bhop_museum1. It utilizes Tony's non-linear checkpoint system and the map can be completed in any variation. There are four wings in total, with the "north wing" being the last one to complete. 

West Wing - Features large hallways that lead into red art rooms with some models & features showcased. Mostly featured on artwork in antiquity. Most of the artwork is unique to the map but there is some featured from museum1

East Wing - A series of green, modern art rooms that are intertwined with each other. Not that the map itself is very "realistic", but this is probably the least immersive stage in the map.

Atrium/Cafe Wing - This "wing" features a hallway that connects you into a mini cafe section, then into an atrium and then into a temple that is currently being renovated. If I'm being honest, this wing was plagued with FPS issues so I had to scale back some of the things. Originally, there was a stonehenge model but I decided the extra FPS was more important.

North Wing - The North Wing is the last wing to be completed and features the checkpoint teleporter at the beginning of the hallway. This wing is inspired by the starting room in museum1, however it is unique. The end zone is on the 2nd story of the room.

Bonus 1 - The first bonus starts in a bathroom that is connected to one of the West Wing hallways. You bhop through both male and female bathrooms, into a vent, then you drop & spin into an office room, followed

name: bhop_museum
description:
Bhop_museum is a map that features Tony Montana's non-linear checkpoint system. The map spawns you in at the start point in the middle of the map. From here, you have the freedom to choose which path you want to go first, and which paths you want to go from there.

The map features four wings:

Military Wing
Classical Wing
Modern Wing
Cultural Wing

Each of these hallways leads to a room that must be completed. Upon completion, you may use the booster and elevate yourself up to the red platform above spawn. Which will then teleport you to the end room. Nonetheless, I am proud of this map and I believe it to my best. I have a very unhealthy tendency to get obsessed with a map, and grind all of my free-time with it. Funny enough, I made the map in about 8 days. However, each of those days I literally spent 8-14 hours grinding it out (I really, really wish I was exaggerating). I hope that everybody can appreciate it, as it is my first map with a truly unique theme.

All of the paintings and text were originally uploaded by me.

The gameplay overall is tier 3, with segmented times running from 1:30 to 1:40. A few of the wings have multiple route and skip options depending on how much speed you are. Also, due to the non-linear nature, there should be a lot of replayability. Hopefully if I designed the map decently, there should be a few decent viable level orders. There is also a 20-30 second bonus. The bonus teleporter is stuck behind the first wing (military wing). Thank you guy

The intention of this map was to create a very old-style feel for a surf map. This was done with easy yet fast obstacles and turns, with relatively small ramps of varying sizes.

In the hub you can find the 8 bonuses. Bonuses 1-6 are labeled at their respective doors, bonus 7 is labeled as "1.6" at its door, and bonus 8 is an unlabeled door on the outside of the hub and can be seen from spawn.

The bonuses are meant to be a wide mix of styles such as fast strafing bonuses, tougher unit-check bonuses, and smooth maxvel bonuses.

Bonus 7 is known as the "1.6 bonus" as it was intended to replicate the old style of cs 1.6 surf / kz. With that being said, it is also meant to be played with autohop and essentially every skip you can find is allowed.

Thanks to everyone who tested and special thanks to Sam for helping me not mess up all the filters in my map.

Thanks to everyone who plays this map.. Enjoy!

name: surf_ember2
description:
I'm not sure how I ended up here, last thing I remember... I was playing with my hotwheels. Now I'm stuck inside what seems to be a dark industrial area on a distant planet. Through the bars I  see a dead, Mars-like desert. Black metal and red accents carve out a tunnel that feels more like the inside of an engine than a building. The bright lights from stark white panels and thin neon trims were daunting at first, but I suppose it's better than being exposed to the deathly heat of this planet. As I surf I pass over windowed grates that preview the chambers and their geometry below. The caged windows give short glimpses of dunes, distant mountains, and a low hazy sun outside.

I think it's meant to feel like riding a thermal radiation line on a cooling ember. It's quiet, contained, and a bit ominous, all while allowing you glimpses of the planet to remind you that you're trapped inside, your movements a mere echo on it's surface.

name: surf_grassland
description:
I dropped into the first ramp and realized something in here was watching my line.

The grass is too smooth, it feels groomed. Every twist of the ramp lines you up a little too perfectly for the next corner, like someone three feet tall with very strong opinions about flow spent a century sanding it down. And when you start going fast the walls stop being just walls.

They… flicker.

You’re carving along the curve, hugging the stone, and out of the corner of your eye the brick pattern breaks. For a split second you see this blur parallel with you, same speed, same angle, a tiny surfer made of moss and stone. Look straight at it and it’s gone. Look away and there it is again, racing you, hat trailing behind.

 Little afterimages darting near you in the grout lines, sprinting around inside the geometry, nudging you a few pixels higher when you should’ve clipped, whispering corrections through the angle of the ramp.

I haven’t actually seen one... never a full face, never a full body. But when the corridor bends and the walls seem to lean in, and the stone hums under as you pick up speed, it’s obvious.

The gnomes are in the walls!

name: surf_lessons
description:
=surf_lessons made by [WF] Helix=

This map was ment to be released for my clanmembers only, but I decided to release it publically instead so other people can learn how to surf in a playful way aswell. This is my first map ever. 

-The basics- 
The map is designed to teach you who to surf. You can find questionmarks on every surf stage. When you stand inside of this, full instructions will be given to you, telling you how to complete a stage. 

There are 7 stages, advancing in difficulty. When you complete the map, you will be teleported back to the spawn where you can pick a bonus stage to practice surfing on a higher difficulty level. Please note that the map has no jail or anything. This will give you unlimited surfing time. 

-Bonus stages- 
The bonus stages need to be activated before you can play them. You can do this by pressing secret buttons that are hidden somewhere in the 7 lessonstages. There is a total of 3. They are hidden and invisible. Once pressed, the teleporter at the spawn to the dedicated bonus stage will be activated. When pressing such button, you will be notified which stage is unlocked. Can you find them? 

I hope you will have fun, and of course that you will learn something from this. If you have any questions or comments, feel free to message me over Xfire by adding me as a friend under the name ''gforce2314'' Cheers.

name: bhop_nature
description:
This probably took me a bit long. 

It all started out being more or less likely, a casual stonewall map with default valve textures. When i was done after 5-6 weeks i decided to get a test for the map. Before i released it i needed some few fixes for the gameplay, so i let it stay in my folder in some weeks before i finally took myself together to fix the issues. 

Although i ended up almost remaking the map completely. I started seeing the map from another perspective, and how things could be better. When i opened my eyes up for it, i realised i could add more detailed content and a way more immersive choice of lightning and overall environment from shadows. All the lights have been recolored a tons of times and got a more fitting brightness, yet the textures has been re-done a million of times to make them fit more together as the ones next to them in the same area/spot. Details around, over and under gameplay has got an organized choice of ideas, and there is most likely not a spot in the map that i didn't thought of adding more detail to. Gameplay started out being way more flat and basic. Now the map has more variety.

I simply learned to critique my own creations way more, and now the map is next to flawless regarding aligned textures and grid fitting creations.

I started the project 13 months ago, and has around 6 months of work. I'd say thanks to George and Panzer for support throughout the days. And for Tony Montana making a great map trailer.

name: bhop_rainbowroad
description:
My longest bhop map yet, It may seem random if you have never played Mario Kart but the design is obviously inspired by the 'Rainbow Road' track from that game, I have wanted to make a map inspired by that track for so long so I decided to do it, obviously I couldn't copy the same track so I just put my own twist on it. This map is pretty different not only from all my other maps but from most bhop maps in general, the gameplay is basically based around avoiding obstacles and gaining as much speed as possible in order to pull off the many skips in this map. Any bhopper of any skill level can beat this, but to be able to pull off every skip will take some patience and quite some time spent routing (at least for me it did) Map is designed to be fun to be played both fast and slow (but ideally fast since its rather largely scaled) If you choose to not do the fast route you will probably find you'll be losing speed quite frequently, I designed this map specifically to reward players for being fast and smooth. As I said there's several skips in this map, some of which are a lot harder than others.  Also has a little bonus I made quickly because I burned myself out making the main map and was really tired with this project by the end. This was just me experimenting and making something I thought would be fun so don't take it too seriously.

It isn't perfect, but I'm happy with it.

name: bhop_whiteglow
description:
Yo, this is my second map, i kinda went with the same theme as my first map, however this time i tried experiencing with some new stuff, using realworldtextures instead of my own ones made in microsoft paint, i tried using some displacements and a 3d skybox. In the end i didnt end up using a 3d skybox because i couldnt get it to work properly. 

I have also tried to build in some 64 unit shortcuts in the map for more advanced players that wish to run the map.

Map is doable on scroll as well, however all shortcuts may not be doable on scroll.

In some areas of the map, different sections of the map can be seen through the skybox, i tried fixing this with hints and skips but im still new to hammer and couldnt manage to get it working after spending hours on it. Especially at the last stage where you can see the two displacements from the end, if anyone has an idea on how to cut a skip/hint to stop that from being seen id love to know, i feel like ive tried everything. 

Also thanks to Promises, AM, kav, Oli and Nato for coming with a ton of feedback and playtesting the map on multiple occasions.

Any feedback that can help me improve and become better at working with hammer is appreciated.

name: bhop_greenglow
description:
A map i had planned to do because of all the positive feedback ive had on my previous maps, i kind of just wanted to continue the 'bhop_insertcolorglow' maps, this time i tried some new stuff, making all of the walls consist of three brushes instead of just having one, adding more textures and some extra detials, however i skipped displacements which i had planned to have because it didnt look very good.

Ended up changing some textures because the ones i had planned to use orginally didnt go well with the lighting.

For the game play in the map its not very difficult at all, all platforms have about a 64-128 unit gap between them, so it can easily be done on scroll as well as normal, but similar to my previous map (bhop_whiteglow) i decided to add a few 64 unit shortcuts available for more advanced players running the map on auto.

I also learned from some mistakes that i made during bhop_whiteglow, where some parts of the map could be seen through the skybox, this is something ive completely avoided this time.

Also thanks to Asko for suggesting more height difference in the platforms as well as having less annoying 180 and 360 turns in the map.

The map is around 40 seconds long (shorter than i had intended), thanks to Asko for providing a video of his run during play testing. (This is not the final version of the map)

name: bhop_blueglow
description:
Hi, this is the 4th map in my "bhop_insertcolorglow" series, in this one i focused more on making the map longer as well as adding some fairly difficult shortcuts for more advanced players, this involves multiple 64 unit shortcuts, some shortcuts along the walls like in previous maps for both advanced and mid level players.

The map is like always possible on scroll as well as auto, as for other styles i dont really care too much about, for example low gravity. (rly silly imo) So for low grav or "unreal" you might hit some player clips above you, but the map is intended for auto/scroll so if you decide to play low gravity or something similar then you will just have to deal with that.

The map should be around 50-60 seconds if all shortcuts are used, however i dont have any proof of this cuz i havent seen anyone actually complete it all in one go during play testing which people did during previous maps, so hopefully this one will be a bit more challenging, and if its too difficult or too simple, please let me know in the comments below. 

Other than that, hope you enjoy the map, have fun bhoppin' :3

name: bhop_redglow
description:
Hi, this is my 5th map in the colorglow series, this time its redglow, like always its possible on both scroll and auto, and probably all other styles as well. This one features some different platforms and i also tried not adding too many shortcuts in this one (i think blueglows shortcuts made it possible to skip too much of the map), i went with one near the end that would allow more advanced players to save a jump or two but other than that its pretty much straight forward. The map is a quite small but offers some height variation and hopefully some interesting gameplay, when i started making the map i basically just placed a huge square and started working around it to make the map. 

Can admit i havent put a ton of work into this since i was just bored one day and mapped for 4-5 hours and pretty much made the entire thing, after that i let some people playtest it and made some changes based on the feedback i got from testing it for 3 days.

Map is around 40 seconds fully routed. Hope ya all enjoy it n have fun hoppin' :3

name: bhop_purpleglow
description:
A map i started working on about 4-5 days ago, basically made the entire thing then did some play testing with a couple friends before i added triggers/playerclips to see what they thought, they liked the game play so i added some triggers, clips and improvements based on feedback. As well as some small detailing, was mostly square shaped rooms to begin with. 

Then Nairda was nice enough to let me playtest the map on the Ultima WL server, so a huge thanks to him and everyone who play tested it with me and gave feedback.

I aimed for this map to be a bit longer than the maps i usually make, kind of like rgbglow but rgbglow had a lot of annoying parts which made running it kinda meh, this map however features quite a lot of boosters and possible 'spins' so if youre not a big fan of those it might not be your favorite to run at max speed (only rly an issue if ure going for the most optimal run, but i have tweaked the parts multiple times to make it easier and not as frustrating)

If its too much please let me know for my next map so i know what to change, im always looking to improve at map making (funny how i say this yet i keep making glow maps xd, maybe one day ill make something more creative)

A very easy speedrun map set between the duality of ice and fire.

It's set between two levels, Ice and Fire. -Both levels are very easy and the map should only take about 30 seconds to complete on auto, or about 1 minute on scroll. -Intended to be speedrun on auto, there are a few sweet skips that I'm sure matmo will find in 10 minutes and ruin my map again :^) Special thanks: -HUGE thanks to Juxtapo for fixing FPS issues. ------------------------ V2: Fixed FPS problems on the lava stage (thx Juxtapo) Removed HDR Lighting Changed around a few triggers and clip brushes As a bit of a retrospective, I agree with everyone saying that pologos was better. There are two secrets, the first is a secret red button in the shape of a grenade and when you push it once, it gives you a grenade, after its pushed 10 times it disables. There is also a secret red music button with sparks flying out of it and its in the shape of an X, when its pushed 10 times it plays the song the final countdown; the song can only be played once per round. Both buttons turn you red if you push then so you can be identified by an admin if he doesn't want anybody pushing them. I hope I see this on some popular servers and I hope you enjoy the map!

name: surf_dune
description:
A dune is a hill or ridge of sand formed by the wind, typically found on beaches, in deserts, or along coastlines where loose sand is abundant.
 These landforms are created when wind transports sand particles and deposits them in a specific location, often accumulating in the lee of obstacles like plants or buildings.
 Dunes are dynamic features, constantly shifting and moving due to wind action, with processes like saltation, creep, and sheet flow contributing to their movement.
 The term "dune" originates from French, Middle Dutch, or Low German, likely from a Gaulish root meaning a mound or hill of loose sand.

name: sj_jabroni
description: sj_jabroni is the ultimate test of Demoman mastery, a vertical gauntlet built entirely around airpogo technique. Instead of guiding players forward, the map drives them skyward through a colossal shaft that narrows as it rises, demanding flawless sticky placement, rhythm, and precision. The opening climbs lull you in with forgiving holes and wide spacing, but the difficulty ramps relentlessly: angled ledges punish sloppy control, protruding obstacles force split-second adjustments, and long stretches leave no room for recovery. Checkpoints are rare, often only after brutal endurance runs of 20+ chained pogos, and missing even one means plummeting back down. At higher levels, ceilings close in so tightly that players must vary detonation timing to thread perfect arcs, balancing vertical thrust with micro-air strafes to stay aligned. No shortcuts exist—only sustained discipline, endurance, and mechanical perfection will see you through. The finale is infamous: a single, towering climb of uninterrupted pogos in a shaft so narrow it feels suffocating, capped by an explosive launch into open sky. Known in the community as a rite of passage, sj_jabroni is less a map than a proving ground, separating casual Demomen from true airpogo elites.

name: surf_utopia
description:
Finally, surf_utopia is released for my birthday. This is a highly detailed linear surf map with a huge focus on the jail. There are 6 endings in the surf which all lead to different locations in the jail. This map also has a kill system in the jail which opens hatches in the ceiling at random and drops explosive crates.

Fun Facts:
- The compile for this map takes up 99.5% of the max brush sides.
- The jail alone takes up about 20% of the max brush sides.
- This map took over 5 months to make from start to release. I'd also like to thank everyone who played this on Final Destination before the release and gave me feedback to improve this massive map.
